tasks.label: Build and validate FPL Hafid
tasks.command: npm run build

tasks.label: Copy assets and build app
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (!(Test-Path 'public/images')) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'public/images' | Out-Null }; Copy-Item -Force 'IMG_6876.png','IMG_7050.jpeg' 'public/images'; npm.cmd run build"

tasks.label: Commit and push website updates
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "git status --short; git add .; git commit -m 'Fix FPL fetch logic and update brand assets'; git push origin main"

tasks.label: Push final FPL Hafid changes
tasks.command: "C:/Program Files/Git/cmd/git.exe" status --short; "C:/Program Files/Git/cmd/git.exe" add .; "C:/Program Files/Git/cmd/git.exe" commit -m "Fix FPL fetch logic and update brand assets"; "C:/Program Files/Git/cmd/git.exe" push origin main

tasks.label: Git push verified site updates
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "& { & 'C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe' status --short; & 'C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe' add .; & 'C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe' commit -m 'Fix FPL fetch logic and update brand assets'; & 'C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe' push origin main }"

tasks.label: Push final GitHub commit
tasks.command: cmd /c "\"C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe\" status --short && \"C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe\" add . && \"C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe\" commit -m \"Fix FPL fetch logic and update brand assets\" && \"C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe\" push origin main"

tasks.label: Git publish latest site fixes
tasks.command: cmd /c "\"C:/Program Files/Git/cmd/git.exe\" status --short & \"C:/Program Files/Git/cmd/git.exe\" add . & \"C:/Program Files/Git/cmd/git.exe\" commit -m \"Fix FPL fetch logic and update brand assets\" & \"C:/Program Files/Git/cmd/git.exe\" push origin main"

tasks.label: Push verified website commit
tasks.command: "C:/Program Files/Git/bin/bash.exe" -lc 'git status --short; git add .; git commit -m "Fix FPL fetch logic and update brand assets"; git push origin main'

tasks.label: Git status check
tasks.command: & 'C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe' status --short

tasks.label: Git add changes

tasks.label: Git commit changes

tasks.label: Git commit verified site fix
tasks.command: & 'C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe' commit -m 'Fix FPL fetch logic and update brand assets'

tasks.label: Git push to origin main

tasks.label: Probe production FPL behavior
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "node -e \"fetch('https://fantasy.premierleague.com/api/entry/2281/').then(r => r.text()).then(t => { console.log('status', r.status); console.log(t.slice(0, 300)); });\""

tasks.label: Verify production fix builds cleanly
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "npm.cmd run build"

tasks.label: Commit and push null-safe FPL fix
tasks.command: & 'C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe' status --short; & 'C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe' add .; & 'C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe' commit -m 'Handle null current event and empty squad gracefully'; & 'C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe' push origin main

tasks.label: Inspect live FPL entry payload
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://fantasy.premierleague.com/api/entry/2281/' -UseBasicParsing).Content | Select-Object -First 1 | Out-String"

tasks.label: Build and verify local fix
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "npm.cmd run build"

tasks.label: Verify final FPL fixes build
tasks.command: npm.cmd run build

tasks.command: & 'C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe' -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (!(Test-Path 'public/images')) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'public/images' | Out-Null }; Copy-Item -Force 'IMG_6979.jpg','IMG_6980.jpg','IMG_6981.jpg','IMG_6982.jpg' 'public/images'; Get-ChildItem 'public/images' | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name"
